title: Accelerating Large Language Model Reasoning via Speculative Search
authors_zh: Zhihai Wang、Jie Wang、Jilai Pan、Xilin Xia、Huiling Zhen、Mingxuan Yuan、Jianye Hao、Feng Wu
paper_type_zh: 推理数据、搜索或测试时扩展研究
best_for_zh: 需要核查推理轨迹、反馈契约、发布边界和复用风险的读者
one_line: An ICML 2025 tree-search accelerator that accepts PRM-scored small-model thoughts above a history-based threshold and replaces rejected thoughts through lossless large-model speculative decoding.
这项 ICML 2025 工作是一种树搜索加速器，接受过程奖励模型打分高于历史阈值的小模型思路，并用无损的大模型推测解码替换被拒绝的思路。
why: For rollout and test-time trace curation, it exposes the thought, score, dynamic threshold, accept-or-correct decision, and search state that should be retained, while the official release stops at code rather than auditable trace data.
inclusion_reason: SpecSearch defines an auditable test-time trace-selection interface: a PRM scores small-model thoughts, a history-based threshold accepts or rejects them, and rejected thoughts are replaced by large-model-distribution corrections before tree search continues.

title: Problem
问题
html: Tree-search reasoning expands many intermediate thoughts, and the paper reports that thought generation accounts for more than 91% of runtime in its measured beam-search and MCTS settings. Standard token-level speculative decoding can accelerate each completion, but it ignores the thought-as-node structure and still asks the large model to participate throughout search. SpecSearch addresses the narrower problem of accelerating node expansion while trying to retain the PRM-defined quality of a large-model thought generator. For this atlas, the relevant object is not a released dataset: it is the per-expansion record of candidate thoughts, PRM scores, a dynamic rejection threshold, accept-or-correct decisions, search state, and the final selected path.

树搜索推理需要扩展大量中间 thought；论文在所测的 Beam Search 与 MCTS 设置中报告，thought 生成占总运行时间的 91% 以上。标准 token 级 speculative decoding 能加速单次生成，但没有利用“thought 即树节点”的结构。SpecSearch 聚焦加速节点扩展，同时尽量保留由 PRM 定义的大模型 thought 生成质量。对本图谱而言，关键对象不是已发布数据集，而是每次扩展中的候选 thought、PRM 分数、动态拒绝阈值、接受或纠正决策、搜索状态与最终选定路径。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: SpecSearch inserts a draft-evaluate-reject-correct module wherever a search algorithm expands a node. A small model drafts N variable-length thoughts in parallel and an existing thought evaluator, usually a PRM, scores each one. A thought at or above the current step-wise threshold is accepted; a lower-scoring thought is discarded and replaced in full through lossless token-level speculative decoding with the large model. Scores from corrected large-model thoughts, together with accepted small-model thoughts used as approximate upper-bound observations, update the next threshold by an exponential moving average. The feedback contract is therefore mixed: a learned process score gates whole thoughts, while large-model speculative decoding supplies distribution-preserving corrections rather than proof that accepted thoughts are correct.

SpecSearch 在搜索算法扩展节点时插入 draft-evaluate-reject-correct 模块。小模型并行起草 N 个变长 thought，再由 PRM 逐个评分。分数不低于当前步阈值的 thought 被接受；分数更低的 thought 被丢弃，并通过以大模型为目标的无损 token 级 speculative decoding 完整重新生成。纠正后的大模型 thought 分数，以及作为近似上界观测的已接受小模型 thought，通过指数移动平均更新下一步阈值。因而其反馈契约是 mixed：学习得到的过程分数负责筛选整个 thought，大模型 speculative decoding 负责分布保持的纠正，但二者都不能证明被接受 thought 必然正确。

title: Method
方法
html: The default experiments pair quantized Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, use MATH-psa as the PRM, set tree width to 6, maximum depth to 50, beam size to 2, and EMA weight to 0.9; Llama3-70B/8B, MCTS with 4 iterations, Math-Shepherd, and smaller Qwen draft models are additional conditions. At step k, six small-model drafts are scored, drafts below the threshold are replaced by large-model thoughts, all surviving or corrected thoughts are returned to the host search, and their scores update the threshold for step k+1. Main evaluation uses 100 randomly selected MATH problems and 100 GSM8K problems. Decoding temperature, seeds, exact sampled IDs, initial threshold, total thoughts per problem, and a raw trace schema are not disclosed in the paper. The author repository provides inference code and scripts, but no pinned release, standalone trace corpus, or repository license was verified.

默认实验将量化 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 与 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 配对，使用 MATH-psa 作为 PRM，将树宽设为 6、最大深度设为 50、beam size 设为 2、EMA 权重设为 0.9；论文还考察 Llama3-70B/8B、4 次迭代的 MCTS、Math-Shepherd 以及更小的 Qwen draft model。在第 k 步，6 个小模型草案接受评分，低于阈值的草案被大模型 thought 替换，全部保留或纠正后的 thought 返回主搜索，并用分数更新第 k+1 步阈值。主评测从 MATH 和 GSM8K 各随机选择 100 题。论文未披露解码温度、随机种子、精确题目 ID、初始阈值、每题 thought 总数和原始轨迹 schema。作者仓库提供推理代码与脚本，但未核验到固定版本发布、独立轨迹语料或仓库许可证。

title: Evidence
证据
html: On Qwen MATH-100, Table 1 reports the same 87% accuracy for autoregressive large-model search and SpecSearch, with average latency falling from 275.78 s to 82.35 s; on Qwen GSM8K-100, latency falls from 138.24 s to 48.18 s while accuracy changes from 97% to 96%. Against lossless speculative decoding, the largest reported speedup in Table 2 is 2.12x with Math-Shepherd, where accuracy is 94% for SpecSearch and 96% for autoregressive search. Ablations on MATH-50 report lower accuracy when PRM evaluation is replaced by large-model log probability or when the dynamic rejection rule is replaced by fixed, random, or fixed-engagement alternatives. These results support the acceleration and component choices under the reported configurations; they do not establish that PRM scores are calibrated, every accepted thought is correct, or the unreported trace records constitute high-quality reusable data.

表 1 在 Qwen MATH-100 上报告，自回归大模型搜索与 SpecSearch 的准确率均为 87%，平均延迟则从 275.78 秒降至 82.35 秒；在 Qwen GSM8K-100 上，延迟从 138.24 秒降至 48.18 秒，准确率由 97% 变为 96%。相对无损 speculative decoding，表 2 报告的最大加速比是使用 Math-Shepherd 时的 2.12x；此时 SpecSearch 准确率为 94%，自回归搜索为 96%。MATH-50 消融实验显示，用大模型 log probability 替代 PRM 评估，或用固定阈值、随机拒绝、固定大模型参与替代动态拒绝规则，都会降低准确率。这些结果支持所设条件下的加速与组件选择，但不能证明 PRM 分数已校准、每个被接受 thought 都正确，也不能证明未报告轨迹是高质量可复用数据。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The method moves speculation from tokens alone to a two-level interface aligned with tree search: semantically variable-length thoughts are drafted and rejected as units, while rejected units are corrected by token-level speculative decoding. Its other distinctive element is the history-based, step-wise threshold intended to approximate the large model's expected PRM quality instead of rejecting a fixed fraction or using a fixed threshold. This differs from standard speculative decoding, which preserves a target token distribution, and from TreeBon's fixed-length sequences and preset rejection proportion. The contribution is an inference recipe and selection contract, not a new PRM, verified process labels, a trace dataset, or proof of final-answer correctness.

该方法把 speculative execution 从纯 token 层面扩展为与树搜索对齐的两级接口：语义上变长的 thought 作为整体被起草和拒绝，被拒单元再由 token 级 speculative decoding 纠正。另一个区别性要素是基于历史的步级阈值，它旨在近似大模型的期望 PRM 质量，而不是拒绝固定比例或采用固定阈值。这不同于保持目标 token 分布的标准 speculative decoding，也不同于 TreeBon 的固定长度序列和预设拒绝比例。该工作的贡献是推理配方与选择契约，而不是新 PRM、已验证过程标签、轨迹数据集或最终答案正确性证明。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The quality guarantee is conditional and narrower than the paper's empirical accuracy metric: it defines quality as expected PRM score and assumes independent normal thought-score distributions, a large-model mean no lower than the small model's, descending large-model quality across steps, bounded variance, and a threshold satisfying the stated condition. The estimator can fail when the PRM is fooled or poorly calibrated; the paper gives a GSM8K example where an incorrect fourth thought scores 0.8916015625 and later steps remain wrong. Accepted small-model thoughts also enter threshold estimation as approximate upper bounds, so evaluator error can propagate through history. Random-item manifests, seeds, decoding temperature, initial threshold, decontamination, raw trees, per-node decisions, and generated-trace licensing remain unknown; the repository exposes code but no licensed trace release or pinned experiment package.

质量保证有条件限制，而且比论文的经验准确率指标更窄：它把质量定义为期望 PRM 分数，并假设 thought 分数独立且服从正态分布、大模型均值不低于小模型、大模型质量随步数下降、方差有界，且阈值满足论文条件。PRM 被欺骗或校准不足时，估计器可能失效；论文给出一个 GSM8K 案例，错误的第四个 thought 得到 0.8916015625，之后的推理仍然错误。被接受小模型 thought 还会作为近似上界进入阈值估计，因此 evaluator 错误可沿历史传播。随机题目清单、种子、解码温度、初始阈值、去污染、原始树、逐节点决策和生成轨迹许可均为 unknown；仓库只提供代码，没有带许可的轨迹发布或固定实验包。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For the rollout/search/test-time-trace track, SpecSearch supplies a concrete schema for recording accelerated search: retain the prompt and prefix, model pair, every draft, PRM identity and score, threshold before and after update, accept-or-correct flag, replacement thought, search depth and state, latency, selected path, and final-answer check. Such records could support selector audits, PRM calibration studies, latency-quality comparisons, or construction of trace-selection datasets. Reuse should preserve rejected candidates and distinguish three predicates: passing the dynamic score threshold, matching the large model's token distribution after correction, and producing a correct final answer. The paper supports test-time compute and evaluation uses only; it does not establish that unreleased traces are licensed, decontaminated, or suitable for SFT or RL training.

对 rollout、搜索与测试时轨迹分类，SpecSearch 给出了记录加速搜索的具体 schema：保留提示与前缀、模型对、所有草案、PRM 身份与分数、更新前后阈值、接受或纠正标志、替换 thought、搜索深度与状态、延迟、选定路径和最终答案检查。这类记录可用于 selector 审计、PRM 校准研究、延迟与质量比较或轨迹选择数据集构造。复用时应保留被拒候选，并区分三种判定：通过动态分数阈值、纠正后匹配大模型 token 分布、产生正确最终答案。论文证据只支持 test-time compute 与 evaluation；它没有证明未发布轨迹已授权、已去污染或适合 SFT/RL 训练。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Treat the object as an inference-time search record, not as a released reasoning dataset.
  • Keep PRM-threshold acceptance, large-model distribution-preserving correction, and final-answer correctness as separate fields.
  • Default settings are width 6, depth 50, beam size 2, MATH-psa, and EMA weight 0.9; decoding temperature, seed, item manifest, and initial threshold remain unknown.
  • Read the theory under its score-distribution and descending-quality assumptions; it does not certify every accepted thought.
  • Benchmark latency and accuracy support the tested selector, not the intrinsic quality or reuse rights of unreported traces.

• 将该对象视为推理时搜索记录，而不是已发布的推理数据集。
  • 将 PRM 阈值接受、大模型分布保持纠正与最终答案正确性保存为不同字段。
  • 默认设置为宽度 6、深度 50、beam size 2、MATH-psa 和 EMA 权重 0.9；解码温度、种子、题目清单和初始阈值仍为 unknown。
  • 理论必须在其分数分布与质量下降假设下解读；它不会认证每个被接受 thought。
  • Benchmark 延迟与准确率只支持所测 selector，不能证明未报告轨迹的内在质量或复用权。

A search tree whose nodes are variable-length reasoning thoughts, with a PRM score and accept-or-correct decision for each drafted node, followed by the host search algorithm's selected reasoning path and final answer.

At every tree expansion, a small draft model generates candidate thoughts; candidates below the dynamic PRM threshold are replaced by full thoughts regenerated through lossless token-level speculative decoding with the large model.
Inference-time tree search; SpecSearch is a node-expansion module demonstrated with beam search and MCTS rather than a training environment.

MATH-psa is the main thought evaluator, with Math-Shepherd tested separately. A step-wise threshold estimates the large model's expected PRM score from corrected large-model thoughts and accepted small-model thoughts, using an exponential moving average.
